say:1:1620139001:1.text: Wow, did you just turn into a wolf? Are you a mage too, like the professor?

say:2:1620139002:1.text: Your magic's incredible! I was in pain everywhere before, but now I feel great!

say:5:1620139004:1.text: Professor Anathyme gave me away, and I followed my new owner to the Dark Forest.
say:5:1620139004:1.source_cn: 嗯，主人把我送给了其他的人，我们一起去了薄暮丛林。
say:5:1620139004:1.male: Professor Anathyme gave me away, and I followed my new owner to the Dark Forest.
say:5:1620139004:1.female: Professor Anathyme gave me away, and I followed my new owner to the Dark Forest.

say:6:1620139005:1.text: It was a breathtaking place, and my new owner treated me well. Even so, I wanted to be with the professor.
say:6:1620139005:1.source_cn: 那是个很美的地方，姐姐对我也很好。但我还是想主人。
say:6:1620139005:1.male: It was a breathtaking place, and my new owner treated me well. Even so, I wanted to be with the professor.
say:6:1620139005:1.female: It was a breathtaking place, and my new owner treated me well. Even so, I wanted to be with the professor.

say:7:1620139006:1.text: One day, I died, but my spirit lingered. Free to travel far and wide, I decided to come back and look for the professor.
say:7:1620139006:1.source_cn: 有一天我死了，但是我没有消失，变成了能走很远的灵体！我...

say:7:1620139006:1.female: One day, I died, but my spirit lingered. Free to travel far and wide, I decided to come back and look for the professor.

say:8:1620139007:1.text: The journey was long, but I met many kind spirits along the way. They pointed me in the right direction and even taught me spirit-binding.
say:8:1620139007:1.source_cn: 路很远，但我遇到了很多好心的灵体。大家帮我指路，还教我...
say:8:1620139007:1.male: The journey was long, but I met many kind spirits along the way. They pointed me in the right direction and even taught me spirit-binding.
say:8:1620139007:1.female: The journey was long, but I met many kind spirits along the way. They pointed me in the right direction and even taught me spirit-binding.

say:9:1620139008:1.text: I turned into the wheels of a carriage, the nets of a fishing boat, the fruit carried by birds, seeds drifting through the air…
say:9:1620139008:1.source_cn: 我变成了马车的轮子、轮船的渔网，鸟抓着的果实，四处飞的...

say:9:1620139008:1.female: I turned into the wheels of a carriage, the nets of a fishing boat, the fruit carried by birds, seeds drifting through the air…

say:10:1620139009:1.text: By the time I reached the school, the place I grew up, the professor was no longer there.
say:10:1620139009:1.source_cn: 可等我找回学校，回到我长大的地方，主人已经不在那里了。
say:10:1620139009:1.male: By the time I reached the school, the place I grew up, the professor was no longer there.
say:10:1620139009:1.female: By the time I reached the school, the place I grew up, the professor was no longer there.

say:13:1620139011:1.text: I found the professor's grave one day! I knew she was here somewhere, but I just couldn't see her.
say:13:1620139011:1.source_cn: 我找到了主人的墓，她就在这里！可我怎么也见不到她。
say:13:1620139011:1.male: I found the professor's grave one day! I knew she was here somewhere, but I just couldn't see her.
say:13:1620139011:1.female: I found the professor's grave one day! I knew she was here somewhere, but I just couldn't see her.

say:14:1620139012:1.text: I got anxious, and whenever that happens, I can't help but jump around.
say:14:1620139012:1.source_cn: 我很着急，一着急就想到处跳。
say:14:1620139012:1.male: I got anxious, and whenever that happens, I can't help but jump around.
say:14:1620139012:1.female: I got anxious, and whenever that happens, I can't help but jump around.

say:15:1620139013:1.text: Back then, whenever I climbed all over her while she was sleeping, she would sit up and pat my head.
say:15:1620139013:1.source_cn: 而且，以前主人睡觉的时候，我跳到她身上，她就会坐起来摸...
say:15:1620139013:1.male: Back then, whenever I climbed all over her while she was sleeping, she would sit up and pat my head.
say:15:1620139013:1.female: Back then, whenever I climbed all over her while she was sleeping, she would sit up and pat my head.

say:16:1620139014:1.text: So, I thought I could make her wake up by jumping longer.
say:16:1620139014:1.source_cn: 我想，说不定我跳久一点，主人就又醒过来啦。
say:16:1620139014:1.male: So, I thought I could make her wake up by jumping longer.
say:16:1620139014:1.female: So, I thought I could make her wake up by jumping longer.

say:17:1620139015:1.text: And it worked! She really appeared from the grave!

say:17:1620139015:1.male: And it worked! She really appeared from the grave!
say:17:1620139015:1.female: And it worked! She really appeared from the grave!

choice:12:0:1.male: Why have you been jumping around?
choice:12:0:1.female: Why have you been jumping around?
